messages.subject: Re: Error: Sensitivity Analysis
messages.body_plain:
I think you are using sensitivity analysis with multi-variable regression approach. R cannot perform regression in this case (only parameter for CN2 is changing, other parameters is constant) -> the program stops. There is something strange with your approach, you don't need to perform sensitivity analysis because the result will show that CN2 is the most sensitive parameter. To see how CN2 affects the objective function values you can see directly when calculating the objective function
